title: Commercial Administrator
description:
Commercial Administrator

Location: Bedford
Salary: £30,000 per annum

Full time: Monday-Friday 8am-5pm 1 hour lunch

We are looking for an organised and proactive Commercial Administrator to join our clients growing team in Bedford. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administrative skills who enjoys working in a fast-paced construction environment and supporting the commercial team.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with all commercial functions within the department.
- Process subcontractor payroll accurately and on time.
- Price and process contract variations.
- Process purchaser extras and maintain accurate records.
- Update and maintain subcontractor retention schedules.
- Enter variations and purchaser extras into monthly valuations.
- Reconcile payments and investigate discrepancies.
- Chase outstanding payments and maintain payment records.
- Update and maintain subcontractor information using Priceworx software.

About You

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous administration experience, ideally within construction or a commercial environment.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good communication skills with the ability to build relationships with colleagues and subcontractors.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office. Experience with Priceworx would be advantageous but is not essential as training can be provided.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

Please note that at times due to the volume of applications we may not be able to respond to each person individually. If you do not hear from us within 7 days we're sorry you have not been successful this time. Please do not let this stop you applying for other positions you may be suitable for. Good Luck!

1st Choice Staff Recruitment is an equal opportunities employer and acts as both an Employment Agency & Business.

title: Graduate Town Planner
description:
Graduate Planner

Bedford

Permanent

Our client, an established planning consultancy is urgently looking to appoint an ambitious Graduate Town Planner to work as part of their established team in Bedford. The successful Graduate Town Planner will be working alongside Senior Planners to deliver planning applications, appeals and site assessments for predominantly residential, rural, mixed use and commercial schemes.

For this role candidates are sought with:
- A relevant town planning/ related degree and ideally a further MSc
- An ambition to purse Chartered Planner status
- Some town planning experience
- A full UK drivers licence

Duties:
- Assisting with the preparation and submission of planning applications
- Conducting planning research and policy reviews
- Drafting planning statements, appraisals and appeal documents
- Liaising with local authorities and statutory bodies
- Supporting public consultation and stakeholder engagement activities
- Assisting with client relationship management
- Delivering advice to clients

Benefits:
- Joining an established company with excellent career progression opportunities
- Competitive starting salary and benefits package

Interested? To discuss this vacancy and other positions within the town planning sector, please do not hesitate to contact HARRIET ROIGE on (phone number removed) or email your CV to (url removed) and we will get back to you.

title: Operations Administrator
description:
Operations Administrator Bedford £30,000 - £35,000 + Benefits

Keep Things Moving. Keep Teams Connected. Make It Happen.

Are you an organised, proactive administrator who thrives when there's plenty going on?

entrustIT Group is looking for an Operations Administrator to join our growing team in Bedford and play a key role in keeping our people, projects and customers moving in the right direction.

We deliver innovative structured cabling, electrical, WiFi, CCTV and access control solutions across the UK. Behind every successful installation is a busy Operations Team - and we're looking for someone who can help keep everything running smoothly.

The Role

This is a varied, fast-paced role where no two days are likely to be the same.

Working closely with the Operations Manager and wider Operations Team, you'll provide essential administrative and coordination support, helping schedule people and resources, communicate with clients and ensure our engineers have everything they need to deliver an outstanding service.

You'll Be Doing Things Like:
- Scheduling engineers, people and resources across jobs and sites
- Organising certifications, access passes, accommodation and expenses for UK-wide teams
- Liaising directly with clients to answer queries and coordinate engineer activity
- Supporting the management and administration of the company vehicle fleet
- Coordinating and administering subcontractors
- Working closely with the Compliance Team to ensure people and projects operate safely
- Managing scheduled maintenance and reactive repairs for CCTV and access control customers
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to the Operations Manager and wider team

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a highly organised team player who takes pride in getting things right and delivering a first-class service.

You'll ideally have:
- Proven experience in an administrative role
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- A genuine passion for quality and customer service
- The ability to work effectively as part of a busy team
- GCSE Maths and English at Grade A -C, or equivalent
- A full, clean UK Driving Licence
- The ability to successfully complete an Enhanced DBS check

Experience of operational administration, or a CIPD Level 3 qualification/membership, would be an advantage.

What's In It For You?
- £30,000-£35,000 salary
- 28 days' annual leave, including Bank Holidays
- The opportunity to join a growing and innovative technology business
- A varied role with genuine responsibility and plenty to get involved with
- A collaborative team environment where your contribution really matters

Join the Team

If you're an organised administrator who loves keeping things on track, communicating with people and making sure nothing falls through the cracks, this is your chance to become a key part of a growing Operations Team.

Ready to make things happen? Apply today and join entrustIT Group.

title: Receptionist
description:
Temporary Receptionist

Location: Bedfordshire

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a receptionist to join their team on a short term temporary basis. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys being the first point of contact for visitors and clients. As a Receptionist, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of the reception area and providing exceptional service to all visitors.

Responsibilities:
- Open and close reception, ensuring the front-of-house area is well presented.
- Greet visitors, answer phones, and manage reception email inboxes.
- Coordinate meeting rooms, including bookings, set-up, signage, and refreshments.
- Sort and distribute post, and manage stationery and office supplies.
- Liaise with facilities and suppliers to support the smooth running of the office.
- Provide administrative support to the events and facilities teams, assisting with ad hoc tasks as required.

Skills and experience:
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a professional approach.
- Highly organised, flexible, and able to manage multiple priorities.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and conducting internet research.
- Strong team player with the ability to work independently and use initiative.
- Excellent attention to detail with high standards of work.
- Reliable, punctual, resourceful, and helpful, with a full UK driving licence.
